title: Serve llms.txt at the site root as plain text
statement: Where the convention is adopted, the file resolves at the root path of the production host, returns a success status, and is served with a plain-text media type rather than as markup or a download.
rationale: A file the convention places at a fixed path is only findable at that path, and a response served as markup or as an attachment is not the plain-text document a consumer expects to parse.
implementation: Publish the file as a static asset at the root rather than through a route that negotiates content, and confirm the media type the origin actually sends rather than the one configured.

verification.method: Fetch the root path for the file and record the status and media type the production host returns.

caution: This is a community proposal, not a standard, and no search platform or assistant operator documents reading it. The record describes how to implement the convention correctly if the site chooses to adopt it, and implies no benefit from doing so.

title: List only absolute HTTPS locations in llms.txt
statement: Every location the file references is written as a complete address including the scheme and host, so a consumer that read the file without recording where it came from can still resolve each entry.
rationale: A relative path only resolves against a base the consumer may not have retained, and a plain-text file carries no element that establishes a base for it.
implementation: Expand each relative path against the production host at build time rather than by hand, so the file cannot drift from the host it is served on.

verification.method: Parse the served file and report any referenced location that is not a complete address on the production host.

caution: Expanding a path to an absolute address is mechanical and reversible, which is why it is permitted automatically. The convention it serves remains unrecognised by any documented consumer.

title: Describe the site and each listed resource factually
statement: The summary of the site and the note beside each entry say what the resource contains, without superlatives, positioning language, or claims that cannot be checked by opening it.
rationale: A note that promotes rather than describes tells a reader nothing about whether the linked resource answers their question, which is the only thing the note is for.
implementation: Write each note from what the target page actually covers, and drop adjectives that would survive unchanged if the page were replaced with a different one.

verification.method: Read each entry's note against the content of the page it points at and report notes that assert qualities the page does not demonstrate.

caution: Nothing documented consumes these notes, so the justification is that a description which cannot be checked is not a description. No effect on any assistant's output is claimed.

title: Exclude private and unpublished locations from llms.txt
statement: The file lists only resources a signed-out reader can already open, and contains no administrative path, no draft, no preview link, and no endpoint that requires a credential.
rationale: The file is a published inventory of the site, so an entry pointing at something unpublished advertises its existence to everyone who reads the inventory.
implementation: Generate the file from the same set of routes the public sitemap is generated from, rather than from a directory listing or a hand-edited list that nothing checks.

verification.method: Request every location the file lists without credentials and report any that returns a challenge, a redirect to authentication, or content marked unpublished.

caution: Removing an entry that should never have been published is permitted automatically because it withdraws information rather than changing behaviour. The claim here does not rest on the convention at all but on the fact that a published list publishes whatever it lists, which is why the record is internal. Removal from this file does not undo the disclosure, so an exposed path still needs treating as exposed.

title: Revalidate llms.txt entries when canonical URLs change
statement: After any change to the canonical address of a listed page, the entry is updated in the same change, and every listed location is confirmed to still resolve without redirection.
rationale: A hand-maintained inventory rots silently, and an entry left pointing at a moved page turns the file into a list of stale addresses that nobody notices because nothing reads it back.
implementation: Regenerate the file from the canonical route set as part of the build, so a URL change updates the entry without anyone remembering to. Fail the build when a listed location does not resolve directly.

verification.method: Request each listed location and report any that redirects or fails, comparing the set against the current canonical route set.

caution: This is maintenance hygiene for a file the site chose to publish. It carries no discoverability claim, and a site that finds the maintenance unjustified is better off removing the file than leaving it stale.

title: Do not present llms.txt as a search or ranking mechanism
statement: Any report, recommendation, or documentation mentioning this file states that no search platform and no assistant operator documents consuming it, and does not describe adopting it as improving visibility, citation, or ranking.
rationale: The convention is widely promoted as an AI visibility measure with no operator documentation behind it, so a report that repeats the promotion transfers an unsupported claim to whoever reads it.
implementation: Describe the file as a community convention the site may adopt, and attach the same statement about undocumented consumption wherever it appears. Do not create the file on a site that has not asked for it.

verification.method: Scan generated reports and documentation for mentions of this file and confirm each is accompanied by the statement that no operator documents reading it.

caution: The absence of operator documentation is what this record rests on, and an absence cannot be cited, which is why it is internal. If an operator does document consuming the file, this record is the one to revisit first.
